admin-bodyPlaceholder: Body (one bullet per line, starting with -)
admin-cardBody: Draft a changelog entry from merged PRs with AI, edit it, and publish it to the changelog.
admin-pastePlaceholder: Paste PR titles and descriptions, one per line or block
badges-blurb: Public SVG badges for your README or site. They show your best score and rank, or your streak, and refresh every few minutes.
hideBots-hint: Leave posts from bot accounts out of your feed on this device. They stay labelled Automated wherever you do see them.
howToPlay-note: AI answers use only this game’s description and can be incomplete.
keys-copy-now: Copy your key now — it won't be shown again.
keys-empty: No keys yet. Create one to get started.
keys-revoke-body: Apps using it will stop working immediately.
keys-rotate-body: The current secret stops working immediately and a new one is issued.
keys-subscription-body: The developer API needs an active HARD-R plan or higher. Your access is checked on every request, so it stays in sync with your subscription.
recipes-blurb: When something happens, do something: post to a Discord channel or notify yourself. Each recipe is rate-limited, and you can keep up to {{max}}.
recipes-createFailed: Check the recipe fields and try again
recipes-t-pb: When I set a personal best
recipes-t-price: When a market item drops below…
testKeys-blurb: An rmh_test_ key works against every endpoint but only returns sample data, and writes are acknowledged without changing anything. Build against it safely.
testKeys-error: Could not create the test key
usage-failed: Could not load usage for this key.
usage-none_one: No requests in the last {{count}} days.
usage-none_other: No requests in the last {{count}} days.
usage-note: Units are cost-weighted: heavier endpoints draw down your daily quota faster than a simple read. Counts settle within a few seconds of a request.
